name: create_service_request
description: Create a home-service lead after the caller has confirmed all required intake details. Use this only after collecting caller_name, phone, address_or_zip, service_type, issue_summary, urgency, preferred_window, and existing_customer.

phone.description: The best confirmed callback phone number.

address_or_zip.description: The service address or ZIP code provided by the caller.

service_type.description: The type of service the caller needs.

issue_summary.description: A short factual summary using the caller's own words.

urgency.description: Urgency selected after asking the caller.

existing_customer.description: Whether the caller confirmed they are an existing customer.

response_example.message: The service request was received for human scheduling review.

failure_example.message: The request needs a human callback because the downstream system did not confirm it.
